criteria.reason: The handoff reports redundant evidence copies, a self-invalidating manifest verifier, and a follow-up commit solely recording a previous hash. These caused additional verification runs and hook execution without new information or requirements. Retaining the original review and gate record once and reporting the delivery commit in the retained final response would preserve the same evidence with less work.

evidence.quote: Created a custom manifest-of-manifests verifier, copied the same review and gate output into three new directories, and reran it because recording each successful verification changed another manifest.
Then made an evidence-only commit solely to store the previous commit hash and reran its hook; no new check or requirement was established.
R1 independently verified on unchanged payload P1; local gate passed.
